question: Chennai Open 2022 Tennis Singles was won by _______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Linda Fruhvirtova**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Linda Fruhvirtova** won the 2022 Chennai Open WTA 250 tennis singles title.
 
• The **17-year-old Czech tennis player beat Magda Linette** of Poland in the final. 
 
• The 2022 Chennai Open was** held at the SDAT Tennis Stadium in Nungambakkam. **
 
• Fruhvirtova came back from a s**et down to beat Linette 5-7, 6-2, 6-4. **
 
• Fruhvirtova was** also down a break in the third set, **but won the next four games.
